integrity: The exact finite distribution reduction is checked by standalone Python enumeration; an analytical moderate-deviation local limit proof supplies the infinite step. This review is not independent validation or a claim of external certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats a specific depth-two counting-modal formula, independent fair unary labels, independent directed edges including loops, one fixed root, and epsilon_n tending to zero. No quantitative uniform error bound or all-formula decidability conclusion; specialist literature could contain an equivalent probabilistic limit.
title: A logarithmic missing-edge crossover for a depth-two counting-modal formula
